question: At equal total charged simulator cost, does explicit exposure to physically generated failed insertion attempts improve a continuous policy's witnessed post-stall and complete-job reliability over ordinary uniform-fault training?
value: Distinguish spending experience on preventing failures from teaching continuation after actual difficulty; determine whether this practical training choice earns its cost against ordinary learning and strong scripted retry.
chosen_contribution: Controlled empirical comparison of physical failure exposure, with paired whole-job/recovery endpoints, all-cost accounting and a physics-stability gate. No new-algorithm or first-recovery-learning claim.

candidate.name: physical_failure_exposure_v1
candidate.prefix: Unchanged initial ActorRetryController insertion commands; no contact-truth-triggered handoff.
candidate.training_actions: Policy controls remaining jobs from start and exposed jobs after fixed prefix. Scripted steps excluded from PPO ratios, value loss and normalization; prefix successes never receive learned credit.
candidate.nominal_practice: Same nominal job distribution and cohort share in both arms. Active nominal transitions are outcomes, reported rather than manufactured equal.
candidate.actor: Same existing feedforward StudyPolicy and noisy actor interface; no phase/contact-truth indicator added.
candidate.reward: Shared completion_credit_v3 with unchanged force/deadline/dwell rules; no reward tuning for exposure.

comparison.ordinary: Fresh uniform-fault PPO with policy control from job start; preserved10M model is diagnostic-only and cannot initialize either arm.
comparison.candidate: Fresh same-architecture PPO with registered physical-prefix exposure.
comparison.practical: Unchanged scripted retry; zero fictitious training cost, measured development/evaluation cost.
comparison.optimizer: Same value-unclipped PPO,1e-4 Adam,4 mini-epochs/minibatch512 and rollout update boundaries. Actual optimizer steps/active samples reported; equal simulator cost is not a claim of identical FLOPs.

budget_rule.provisional_screen: Six1024-equivalent cohorts per arm/start, or three2048 cohorts if capacity supports; exact native cost and any resolution-dependent adjustment frozen in launch registration before training.
budget_rule.extension: If all ordinary and candidate arms remain below50% direct development completion, permit one matched extension to22 1024-equivalent cohorts at the same physical definition, subject to measured overnight budget. If models are competent, extend only for an average >=3/56 paired post-stall-completion gain without >=2/12 nominal loss; no repeat sampler/reward tuning.
budget_rule.physical_validity: No substantial training until contact_impact_registration_v1 acceptance passes. Capacity profiling is separately authorized diagnostic optimization.

endpoints.primary: All-request complete-job reliability, with a separate witnessed-contact-stall continuation assay and paired cases; report each training start.
endpoints.witness: Mechanism-neutral post_stall_completion_v1 and frozen withdrawal metric separately.
endpoints.time: Time per request including aborts/deadlines; mean successful-job time separately.
endpoints.force: Native raw20N aborts and full force distribution; no smoothed-force substitution.
endpoints.generalization: If same-prefix development gain earns extension, preregister an unused3s/5s prefix assay on development seeds before opening final tests; gains confined to trained4s prefix do not establish general recovery teaching.

decision_rule.continue: Cross-start post-stall gain with maintained nominal/direct competence and stable physical interpretation earns larger comparison and later gear test; this screen alone is preliminary.
decision_rule.reject_method: Competent matched arms show no consistent recovery gain, prefix transfer fails, or direct/nominal losses offset recovery; reject this exposure package, not recovery learning generally.
decision_rule.reject_premise: No stable, interpretable force-limited task within registered diagnosis budget: reject current training-comparison premise for this cycle and report the causal numerical limitation.
decision_rule.insufficient: All models weak at the single matched extended budget means insufficient learned competence, not candidate superiority or inferiority.

closest_primary_sources.establishes: Force-aware learned assembly/search, recurrent PPO and domain randomization; not incapable of recovery by design.

closest_primary_sources.establishes: Prior learning from failed tactile traces to update part pose/type beliefs.

scope_and_limitations: Research decision only until launchable source/common task and actual runs exist.
Historical ordinary policy is not candidate evidence. Existing equal47/56 learned/retry completion and lateral correction motivate an open question.
Adaptive sampler and fixed curriculum remain preserved unexecuted designs; this chosen claim concerns physical failure exposure, so a fixed curriculum is not its necessary causal control.
No hardware, pickup, camera perception, force-certified safety, algorithmic novelty or publication-success claim.
